profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Bloomberg
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Hello! I graduated from Northeastern University’s Khoury College of Computer Science  with a BSCS and a concentration in AI. I enjoy building new things, learning from others, teaching others, and contributing to a team’s success. I put a lot value into getting things done in a timely and efficient manner while staying organized. I am currently working at Bloomberg. Feel free to reach out.

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Optimized API response speeds through the implementation of multi-threading techniques, resulting in a 30% reduction in response times and implemented better log coverage.

Redesigned and refactored existing UI components to improve scalability and reusability, resulting in a more intuitive and responsive user interface for 100+ users on different browsers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Spearheaded the conception, development, and design of the backend infrastructure and database schema for a dynamic web application using TypeScript, React, NextJS, and Prisma.
positions.insights: Skills: Relational Databases · Software Design · Diversity · JavaScript · React.js · Full-Stack Development · Object Oriented Design · Teamwork · Back-End Web Development · TypeScript · Next.js · Systems Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Containerized multiple microservices to streamline software delivery and enable rapid scaling, creating self-contained images of each service for greater flexibility and efficiency.

Orchestrated the deployment of these images using Kubernetes and AWS, automating the scaling of pod and worker node instances in response to fluctuating demand and enabling seamless deployment across different environments.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Software Design · Amazon EKS · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · DevOps · Diversity · Full-Stack Development · Teamwork · docker · Kubernetes · Engineering · Git

positions.description: Demonstrated proficiency in designing and implementing robust back-end systems, leveraging a range of RESTful API principles to facilitate seamless data processing and management.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Relational Databases · Diversity · Full-Stack Development · Database Design · Teamwork · Back-End Web Development · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led initiative for code quality gate analysis on pull requests via Jenkins & SonarQube.

Refactored code to identify and force kill processes & services that ignored termination.

Increased code coverage in multiple Java classes using popular mocking framework Mockito.
positions.insights: Skills: Unit Testing · Diversity · Software Documentation · Teamwork · Mockito
